summary: Stellar Bancorp filed an 8-K announcing receipt of all regulatory approvals (Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas, FDIC, Texas Department of Banking) for its merger with Prosperity Bancshares. The merger, under a January 27, 2026 agreement, will see Stellar merge into Prosperity, with Stellar Bank merging into Prosperity Bank. A special shareholder meeting is scheduled for May 27, 2026, with closing expected on or about July 1, 2026, subject to shareholder approval and customary conditions. No financial terms (price per share, premium) were disclosed in this filing. The risk-arb angle focuses on shareholder vote outcome and timeline to close.
